about: Mumbai (IST) civil dates from Drik Panchang, each one confirmed by at least one more independent panchang. Checked on 2 October 2026. A festival that two traditions keep a day apart is listed once, and its note says which one this is. Dates that the sources could not agree on (Maha Navami 2026, Govardhan Puja 2026, Makar Sankranti 2027, Holi 2027, Pitru Paksha 2027, Kartik Purnima 2027) are left out on purpose. Re-check about December 2026, when the Maharashtra holiday list for 2027 comes out.
